keyEvents.text: Goal! Derby County 0, Bolton Wanderers 1. Rúben Rodrigues (Bolton Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gaizka Larrazabal with a cross following a fast break.
First Half ends, Derby County 0, Bolton Wanderers 1.
Goal! Derby County 1, Bolton Wanderers 1. Ryan Nyambe (Derby County) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Mohammed Fuseini.

Goal! Derby County 2, Bolton Wanderers 1. Jack Robinson (Derby County) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Carlton Morris with a headed pass following a set piece situation.
Luca Stephenson (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Kyliane Dong replaces Thierry Gale.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Atsuki Ito replaces Luca Stephenson.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Samuel Iling-Junior replaces Xavier Simons.
Substitution, Derby County. Alex Mowatt replaces Lewis Travis.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Theo Bair replaces Akin Famewo.
Substitution, Bolton Wanderers. Max Lott replaces Rúben Rodrigues.
Substitution, Derby County. Lars-Jørgen Salvesen replaces Carlton Morris.
Substitution, Derby County. Oscar Fraulo replaces Mohammed Fuseini.
Goal! Derby County 3, Bolton Wanderers 1. Rhian Brewster (Derby County) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Rhian Brewster (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for excessive celebration.
Gaizka Larrazabal (Bolton Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Derby County 3, Bolton Wanderers 1.
